mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MEMBER ( MEMBER_NO , MEMBER_NAME , MEMBER_ID , MEMBER_PWD , PHONE , EMAIL , REF_RNO , MEMBER_IMAGE , MEMBER_POINT , ENROLL_DATE , STATUS , ROLE ) VALUES ( SEQ_MNO.NEXTVAL , #{memberName} , #{memberId} , #{memberPwd} , #{phone} , #{email} , #{refRno} , DEFAULT , DEFAULT , DEFAULT , DEFAULT , DEFAULT )
mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID memberId , MEMBER_PWD memberPwd , MEMBER_NAME memberName , ROLE , MEMBER_NO memberNo , PHONE , EMAIL , REF_RNO refRno , MEMBER_IMAGE memberImage , MEMBER_POINT memberPoint , ENROLL_DATE enrollDate FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
SELECT MEMBER_NAME memberName , MEMBER_ID memberId , MEMBER_PWD memberPwd , PHONE , EMAIL , REF_RNO refRno , MEMBER_IMAGE memberImage FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT MEMBER_NO memberNo , MEMBER_NAME memberName , MEMBER_ID memberId , MEMBER_PWD memberPwd , PHONE , EMAIL , REF_RNO refRno , MEMBER_IMAGE memberImage , MEMBER_POINT memberPoint , ENROLL_DATE enrollDate , STATUS , ROLE FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE EMAIL = #{email}
SELECT ROWNUM as "rank" , MEMBER_ID memberId , MEMBER_POINT memberPoint FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE STATUS = 'Y' ORDER by MEMBER_POINT desc FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
